verifications.Rationale: KRAS inhibition suppresses mTOR growth signaling.
verifications.generated_sql:
SELECT
            gs.standard_name AS msigdb_name,
            gs.collection_name AS collection,
            COALESCE(gsd.description_full, gsd.description_brief, '') AS description,
            CASE WHEN gs.standard_name = 'HALLMARK_MTORC1_SIGNALING' THEN 0.99 ELSE 0.1 END AS sql_score
        FROM gene_set gs
        LEFT JOIN gene_set_details gsd ON gsd.gene_set_id = gs.id
        ORDER BY sql_score DESC
        LIMIT 10
verifications.checked_sql:
SELECT *
FROM (
SELECT
            gs.standard_name AS msigdb_name,
            gs.collection_name AS collection,
            COALESCE(gsd.description_full, gsd.description_brief, '') AS description,
            CASE WHEN gs.standard_name = 'HALLMARK_MTORC1_SIGNALING' THEN 0.99 ELSE 0.1 END AS sql_score
        FROM gene_set gs
        LEFT JOIN gene_set_details gsd ON gsd.gene_set_id = gs.id
        ORDER BY sql_score DESC
        LIMIT 10
) AS allowed_candidates
WHERE collection = 'H' OR collection LIKE 'C2:CP%' OR collection = 'C5:GO:BP'
